brief:
Mansour Abbas, the Ra'am party leader, said he supports removing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from office while cautioning that a minority government could trigger fresh elections, according to Maan Wire. Abbas's comments signal potential flexibility on government formation amid concerns about political instability in Israel.

The statement comes as tensions persist within Israel's governing coalition and debate continues over Netanyahu's political future amid legal challenges and internal coalition pressures.
title: Abbas backs Netanyahu ouster, warns minority government risks new elections
